procedure: Used the already-flashed firmware revision 1cfb514 on the attached ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1.
Ran the expanded nSealr/esp32 smoke command make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 idf-smoke-capabilities after adding dynamic request-id exchanges in revision 2f1ca8c.
Reran the expanded smoke after revision 0d9fb0b added invalid dynamic metadata exchanges.
Reran the expanded smoke after revision 8518f98 moved invalid dynamic metadata inputs to shared specs vectors from revision c09474e.
Verified static fixture requests, dynamic request-id variants, and invalid metadata requests for get_capabilities, get_public_key, and sign_event.
expected_result: The device echoes static and dynamic request ids for get_capabilities/get_public_key, refuses static and dynamic sign_event requests with signing_disabled, and rejects invalid dynamic metadata with unsupported_request error frames.
observed_result: The device returned eight valid nseal1f frames: three shared fixture responses, three dynamic request-id responses, and two invalid-metadata error frames. Dynamic get_capabilities and get_public_key returned ok=true, dynamic sign_event returned ok=false with error.code signing_disabled, and invalid version/request_id requests returned nseal1f:error with unsupported_request.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
The firmware was not rebuilt in this report; it reused the already-flashed revision 1cfb514 from the dynamic serial request-id milestone.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.
sign_event is expected to remain disabled until the display, physical approval, provisioning, storage, and signed-output verification gates are complete.
